verdict.rationale: Devin's API and MCP documentation mention a permission system ('MCP tools are subject to the same permission system as built-in tools... control access at multiple levels') and organization-level session creation via create_as_user_id, suggesting some access control exists, but there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys/credentials for agents. Missing for 10: explicit API key scoping/permission levels, documented least-privilege credential issuance workflow, independent verification of granular access control.
